content.short: Magic offers wallet developer tools for Web3 products.
content.description: Magic is a California-based blockchain company founded in 2020 by Jaemin Jin and Arthur Jen, who later formed the Magic Labs team. It provides a developer toolkit designed to streamline Web3 product experiences. By removing the need to download wallets or store private keys, Magic lets users sign up with their email or Google accounts. It also includes a built-in fiat on-ramp for purchasing crypto and NFTs and supports networks such as Arbitrum, Avalanche, BNB Chain, Ethereum, Polygon, Solana, OP Mainnet, Moonbeam, and Polkadot.
content.meta: Magic provides wallet developer tools. Discover Magic and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
